changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 5 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/4795-bindable-text-keys.md`

- names `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` → `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` — edited by this change

  > Published authoring guidance updated to match: `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` (new "Bindable Text Keys" rule), plus the `page-builder`, `schema-expressions` and `data-integration` guides, which taught the now-retired "never evaluated" statement and its host-pre-resolution workaround.

### `.changeset/5120-retire-data-table-name-alias.md`

- names `skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md` → `skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md` — edited by this change

  > The two published skill guides that taught the `name` spelling (`skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md`, `schema-expressions.md`) migrate in this same release, so the platform never refuses a spelling it still ships.

- names `schema-expressions.md` → `skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md` — edited by this change

  > The two published skill guides that taught the `name` spelling (`skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md`, `schema-expressions.md`) migrate in this same release, so the platform never refuses a spelling it still ships.

### `.changeset/6357-basechema-bind-declaration.md`

- names `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` → `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` — edited by this change

  > `bind` was read by ten production sites and declared by no schema shape. It resolved as `any` through `BaseSchema`'s index signature and rode `.passthrough()` on the validator, while three separate documents taught it as an authorable key of *every* node: this repo's own `AGENTS.md` §4 ("Every node in the UI tree follows this shape (`@object-ui/types`)"), the published agent-facing `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` ("Every UI component node MUST follow this shape"), and `content/docs/fields/grid.mdx`. So the agent-facing protocol told authors to write a key the published types did not know existed.

### `.changeset/6575-data-table-bind-diagnostic.md`

- names `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` → `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` — edited by this change

  > The platform was already paying for this in teaching rather than in diagnostics: `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` documents the pothole verbatim and a pin test locks the behaviour. The warning now also reaches the console, where the author who did not read the docs is standing:

### `.changeset/6665-data-table-non-array-data-diagnostic.md`

- names `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` → `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` — edited by this change

  > The spelling that opened the card is a `${...}` expression string, and it is a defect rather than a design because the SAME expression is evaluated one key over. Re-measured on merge-base `5967be095` through the real `SchemaRenderer` (the table was previously quoted from `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` as a measurement on `f1c27f037` and had not been re-run); all four legs reproduced, and they are now pinned as tests rather than prose:

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `cf38a6cec` (merge-base with origin/main): 3 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1959 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2581 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36949888645)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4d99d286d3ab8856a352524d33176dd7bec64835`
Local-runs: none

Face: governed rule text (`skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md`, `skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md`, `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`; objectui `skills/**`), reviewed in-seat by the dispatching seat at the constant's tier. The seat's round-0 verdict on `f7823a63` was a REWORK (5943640678), not a record; this is the record for the landing head. Inputs: objectui#11414 (body and every comment: the claim 5943352305, the round-0 report 5943584257, the REWORK 5943640678, the round-1 report 5943776551), PR #11418's body, its file list (4 files, +24 / −16) and patch against `main` at `cf38a6ce`, and the check-runs on this head as read at this record.

### ① Derived judgments

1. Scope: the card's four sentences (two guides) plus the two sentences the REWORK added — the `data` expression clause in `data-integration.md`, and the 「Both failing legs」 sentence in `protocol.md`, inside the claim surface as amended in 5943640678; every fence, every other sentence, the 「Readers only.」 line PR #11410 landed and objectui#11256's section are byte-identical. RIGHT.
2. 「Every other component ignores `bind` — no error, no warning, nothing in the console — except `data-table` (one warning, below).」, identical in both guides: the only `bind` logger under `packages/*/src` is `dataTableBindDiagnostic.ts` (the dev's source census found no second logger), and the parser tier draws no `unknown-prop` for `bind` (a `BASE_PROPS` row, pinned by `bind-base-prop-parser-tier-11008.test.tsx`). RIGHT.
3. Both `data-table` paragraphs name the render-time `[ObjectUI] DataTable bind:` warning (objectui#6575) as the one signal — the wording PR #11410 landed in `protocol.md`. RIGHT.
4. The `data` expression clause in `data-integration.md`: 「fails the same way, with its own console warning (`[ObjectUI] DataTable data:`, objectui#6665)」 — `describeNonArrayData` fires on a non-array `data`, pinned by `data-table-node-data-diagnostic.test.tsx` (49 / 49 on this head). RIGHT.
5. `protocol.md`, 「Both failing legs fail the same way: a correct header over the empty state, nothing thrown, a console warning each (`[ObjectUI] DataTable data:`, objectui#6665; dev-build `props`-bag warning, objectui#6708).」 The seat's REWORK premise had both rows drawing the `DataTable data:` warning; the dev's one-off probe through the real `SchemaRenderer` measured it FALSE for the `props` row — `props` is spread as React props and never hoisted, so the table's `data` stays undefined and `describeNonArrayData` is correctly silent; that row's one console line is `reportDroppedPropsBag`'s dev-build warning. The sentence follows the measurement and names the second warning as dev-build, so a production reader is promised no line that build does not print. RIGHT; the seat's premise was wrong, the dev's reading stands, and the ACCEPT says so.
6. No accept-set or public-surface change; no fence read by `skill-guide-data-table-binding`, `list-bind-only-11405` or `check-skill-examples` moved. RIGHT.
7. Line budget against the REWORK's +4 across three files: `data-integration.md` 513 → 515, `schema-expressions.md` 635 → 636, `protocol.md` 370 → 371, bundle 4808 → 4812 — exactly +4; `protocol.md`'s line is paid by dropping the connective 「this file keeps warning about」, whose referent is the table directly above. RIGHT.
8. The issue citations follow each file's existing `objectui#NNNN` convention. RIGHT.

### ② Semver level

Docs-only in a governed surface; EMPTY-frontmatter changeset; the phantom `skip-changeset` label correctly not applied; `Clause-②: no`. Consistent.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The PR body was rewritten in round 1 through the relay (`issue_patch`), which the REWORK allowed before the seat adopted it; read back identical (16850 bytes). Accepted.
- One write-pace refusal on the round-1 report's first dispatch (exit 10, nothing written), re-sent once after the window — a container reading, not a defect. Accepted.
- Dev readings, noted not filed: the control row `props: { data: [literal array] }` renders the empty state with no console line at all (no shipped sentence claims otherwise); two test-file header comments carry the old phrase (not shipped, not pins); the chart paragraph in `content/docs/guide/schema-rendering.md` stays unmeasured (a different component).
- `open_questions`: none.
- Check-runs on `4d99d286` at this record: 29 `success`, 8 `in_progress` (Test shards), 0 `failure`; `mergeable_state: blocked` is the draft-with-required-checks reading. Tier H landing: an authorized APPROVED review, then every check green on the landing head; objectui#11256 / PR #11419 edits a disjoint region of `schema-expressions.md`, so whichever lands second is brought up to date first.

## 维护者速读(终稿)

席位(skills 席 1,`session_01FNKm1SmPpuJASnbjxWGtsJ`)对照自读的 diff 与 objectui `main` 校正 dev 草稿后定稿,2026-10-02T01:26Z。

**改了什么。** 两份发布给作者的技能指南(`skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md`、`skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md`)里四句「在 `data-table` 上写 `bind` 什么都不记录 / 其它组件忽略 `bind` 控制台里什么都没有」,改为:无错误、页面无提示,唯一信号是渲染期控制台警告 `[ObjectUI] DataTable bind:`;「其它所有组件」一句原地点名 `data-table` 为唯一例外。返工一轮后再加两句同族假句:data-integration.md 紧随的「把节点 `data` 指向表达式会以同样静默的方式失败」改为点名它自己的警告 `[ObjectUI] DataTable data:`;`rules/protocol.md` 四行表格下的「两条失败腿都 nothing thrown, nothing logged」改为逐腿点名各自的警告(节点 `data` 腿:`DataTable data:`;`props` 包腿:仅 dev 构建下的 props-bag 警告)。三文件合计净增 4 行(预算 +4);示例一字未动;另加空 frontmatter changeset(不发版)。

**为什么改。** 这些句子是 AI 写元数据时读的教材。自 objectui#6575 / #6665 起渲染器对这两种失败都会打控制台警告,教「静默」会让作者去找不存在的静默陷阱、或忽略真实存在的警告。本 PR 是该「静默从句」家族在发布面上的最后六处;protocol.md 的「Readers only.」一句已由 PR objectui#11410 改正。

**风险与代价(含回滚)。** 纯文档改动。风险只在措辞是否精确:席位要求的第二轮里,dev 用真实 `SchemaRenderer` 实测了表格三行的控制台输出,推翻了席位的一个前提(`props` 包那一腿并不打 `DataTable data:` 警告,只在 dev 构建下有 props-bag 警告),文字按实测写。四个 pin 测试 49/49 绿。回滚 = revert 本 PR。

**席位意见。** 建议批准。席内达档契约复核 PASS(见本 PR 评论)。与 PR objectui#11419(同文件不同区域)后落地者需先 update-branch。

**你要做的(一个动作)。** 在本 PR 上留一条 APPROVED review(`os-zhuang` / `hotlong` 任一)。之后由席位 update-branch、清标、翻 ready、挂 auto-merge 入队;不需要你合并。
